_comment: Rubric 0.4.0 (13 November 2026). What each evidence family reads and whose experience it records. The class letter is derived from these two facts by ingest/merge_extra_registry.py and pinned by tests/test_evidence_kinds.py: a family votes when it reads a price, rationing, a costly behaviour or latent demand AND records firms' or markets' own experience; otherwise it informs. Exceptions are listed with their reasons. Regime rules (dollarization, re-export hubs, low voice, high income) still downgrade a voting measure for the economies they name.

price.means: a price, a shadow price or a cost rate that firms or markets actually bear: an interest rate, a return, a spread, a cost as a share of sales or of the shipment, the rate at which money loses value

rationing.means: firms' own experience of rationing, delay or an illicit charge at the going price: outages, a credit refusal, days waiting for a connection or a licence, a bribe request

behaviour.means: a costly behaviour that only pays if the constraint binds: owning a generator, paying for private security, holding dollars, operating informally

latent_demand.means: camels and hippos: firms or exports that depend on the constrained input are missing or grow slower; votes only after passing its placebo and power gates

hazard.means: the hazard itself measured on the population or the economy, not its cost to firms: the homicide rate. A measured fact, so it can corroborate, but its price to firms is not observed

quantity.means: a quantity, stock, access share, balance-sheet ratio or slack measure: a low value can be low demand as well as low supply

perception.means: a stated reason or an opinion: obstacle shares, perceived insecurity, 'no need for a loan'

index.means: a composite of unlike sub-indicators with weights of its author's choosing

own.means: firms', households' or markets' own transactions and experience, or an official statistical series

estimate.means: an expert's estimate for a standardised case (Doing Business, B-READY): the rule on paper, not what firms meet

bank_profitability.why: rubric 0.4.0: an accounting return, not the price a borrower pays, and the same construct as gfdd_profitability, which was already class C

bop_freight_cost.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): what the economy pays non-resident carriers for transport per dollar of goods imported, an ad valorem cost rate from the official balance of payments; not computed for net exporters of transport services

cbcr_tax_rate.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): cash income tax large multinational groups pay over the profit they book in the economy, from their own country-by-country reports compiled by tax authorities; whether a large-multinational rate may vote for the whole economy is rule question 3 of docs/data-extension-plan.md

crowding_out.why: rubric 0.4.0: a share of bank credit; crowding out shows in rates, which the area already reads. Class B before

db_contracts.why: rubric 0.4.0: time and cost for a standardised case as estimated by experts, not what firms meet (Hallward-Driemeier and Pritchett 2015 find little relation between the two), and frozen with the 2019 data except where B-READY continues them. The trade measures were already class C on this ground (v0.1.3); it now applies to every such measure

educated_unemployment.why: rubric 0.4.0: a slack measure; it can argue against scarce skills and cannot argue for them. Class B before

es_customs_days.why: rubric 0.4.0: firms' own experience of rationing or delay, read like the outage count and the connection delay; class C before, by a per-area reading of the workbook that the blind re-rating of 13 November did not reproduce

es_loan_discouraged.why: rubric 0.4.0: a firm's stated reason for not applying; valuable for reading the first decision and shown prominently, but an answer, not a price or a behaviour. Class B before

es_loan_no_need.why: rubric 0.4.0: a firm's stated reason for not applying; valuable for reading the first decision and shown prominently, but an answer, not a price or a behaviour. Class B before

es_loan_rejection.why: rubric 0.4.0: firms' own experience of rationing or delay, read like the outage count and the connection delay; class C before, by a per-area reading of the workbook that the blind re-rating of 13 November did not reproduce

es_outage_incidence.why: rubric 0.4.0: firms' own experience of rationing or delay, read like the outage count and the connection delay; class C before, by a per-area reading of the workbook that the blind re-rating of 13 November did not reproduce

es_tax_admin_delay.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): weeks firms waited for a VAT refund or a final audit report, their own experience of delay, read like the customs and connection delays; kept only where 30 or more firms answered

es_tax_rate_paid.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): the effective income-based tax rate firms report paying, a price they bear, from their own accounts; the Doing Business total tax rate is the expert estimate for a standardized firm and keeps informing

es_tax_time.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): hours a year the median firm spends on tax compliance, a cost it bears, read like management time on regulation

fx_instability.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): how much the official exchange rate against the dollar moved month to month, an official series of the price every importer, exporter and foreign-currency borrower faces; not computed for pegs and informing under hard pegs

gfdd_liquidity.why: rubric 0.4.0: balance-sheet ratios, ambiguous between weak loan demand and weak intermediation, and the same construct as bank_liquidity, which was already class C

gfdd_overhead.why: rubric 0.4.0: banks' cost structure explains the spread and is not the price to borrowers; the spread and the net interest margin stay class A

hci.why: rubric 0.4.0: composites of unlike sub-indicators, like the governance indices; class C before

inflation.why: the rate at which money loses value is a price every holder of money and every nominal contract bears, and the workbook's first class A measure for macro risk; a judgement, recorded here because the homicide rate, also a realised hazard, is read as a hazard and informs

lpi.why: rubric 0.4.0: composites of unlike sub-indicators, like the governance indices; class C before

lpi2_dwell.why: rubric 0.5 (wave 1): median days containers spent in port, from shipment tracking records (World Bank LPI 2.0): delay experienced at the going price, read like the customs days; the perception LPI it replaces keeps informing

remittances.why: rubric 0.4.0: an inflow that follows migration; it says nothing about the price or rationing of foreign finance and could as easily relax the constraint. Class B before, as a 'bypass'

IC.FRM.OUTG.ZS.why: v0.1.2: the published series is the median firm's loss and is zero for most economies, so it cannot carry a class A vote until an all-firms mean exists

IC.FRM.CRDC.PT.ZS.why: the partial measure; the fully-constrained share carries the family's vote

es_informality.why: rubric 0.4.0: one piece of evidence, one area. Informality is a way round regulation and taxes alike; counted in both it flagged both. It stays under regulation, as the tax-gifts measure was moved to corruption alone in v0.1.4
